commands_run: $snap = '...\snapshots\01-market-researcher'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $snap | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force '...\work\*' $snap; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '...\receipts' | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem -Recurse $snap | Select-Object FullName
problems_and_friction: Main difficulty was producing EUR pricing with no web access: vendor list prices shift often and HubSpot's contact-tier/seat hybrid pricing makes a 40-seat estimate genuinely fuzzy, so I flagged everything as +/-20% with an explicit knowledge-cutoff caveat. The work dir contained an empty pre-existing 'snapshots' subdirectory, which got copied into the snapshot as harmless noise. No protocol was given, so I invented a PIPELINE-STATE.md handoff convention for the risk-analyst.
context_understood: Stage 1 of a 3-stage serial pipeline: read brief.md (CRM evaluation for Brightline, a 40-seat Dublin ad agency) and produce comparative market research on Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho for a downstream risk-analyst.
